task_description: Upgrade the existing Traffic Sign Recognition project into a professional, modern, fully functional desktop application. Implement a multi-page CustomTkinter 5.2.2 GUI (dark AI-dashboard theme) with sidebar navigation, image upload, CNN inference via the existing my_model.h5 model, prediction history, dataset/model info pages, settings, and about page. Wire everything to the real trained model with correct preprocessing (grayscale, resize 32x32, /255, expand dims). Add structured service layer and unit tests.
